purpose: Teach: 位相/流体/研磨/僻地/共振/界面/発振/電極

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、量子力学の位相情報を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you focused on quantum phase information in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, curious opening. Gentle confirmation seeking — not testing. Steady eye contact. Pace allows room for her response.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、流体力学の翼設計を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at wing design in fluid dynamics.
lines.style: Direct, clear-voiced answer. Slight lift at the end — the relief of being on solid ground. No defensiveness, just straightforward.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 半導体の研磨技術を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Semiconductor polishing techniques were your focus then?
lines.style: Softer this time, more genuine curiosity. Slight tilt of head. Patient — giving her space to correct if needed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、僻地医療の課題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the challenges in rural medicine.
lines.style: Measured, confident. Small pause before answering — gathering her thoughts, not hesitating. Voice steady and present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 構造物の共振現象を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And structural resonance phenomena — that was part of your work?
lines.style: Engaged but not pushing. There's a rhythm forming now — she notices. Slight warmth in the question, like she's appreciating the breadth of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、化学の界面活性剤を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I researched surfactants in chemistry.
lines.style: Voice has settled in now. Comfortable rhythm. Matter-of-fact but not flat — each topic lands with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 発振回路の設計を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And oscillator circuit design — that was another one?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower. She's piecing something together. Genuine interest beneath the questions. Slight wondering tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、電池の電極材料を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I studied electrode materials for batteries.
lines.style: Final answer carries a small sense of completion. Breath of relief underneath. She's maintained her composure through all of it — a small smile possible.
